title: Smart Data Models - DigitalAssetMetric
description: A digital marketing observation of a DigitalAsset for a specific date and temporal granularity (daily/monthly/quarterly/yearly). Includes traffic, engagement, e-commerce, organic-social and paid-ads metrics. Metrics that admit segmentation by acquisition channel group are arrays of {channelGroup, value}; the rest are scalars. Non-applicable metrics are omitted (sparse schema).

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be DigitalAssetMetric.

dateObserved.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Reference timestamp of the observation (ISO 8601). Combined with `temporalResolution` defines the time window. For daily granularity (P1D) it is the start-of-day in UTC of the observed day

temporalResolution.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. ISO 8601 duration. Granularity of the observation: daily (P1D), monthly (P1M), quarterly (P3M), yearly (P1Y). Each granularity is published as an independent entity to avoid the non-additivity problem of unique-user metrics. Enum:'P1D, P1M, P3M, P1Y'
